**CERTIFICATE OF INSURANCE**

**Alpine IT Solutions LLC**

Policy Year: January 1, 2025 – December 31, 2025

| **Coverage Type** | **Insurer** | **Policy Number** | **Limit** | **Premium** |
| Technology E&O / Cyber Liability | Chubb Group | EO-4421-2025 | $2,000,000 | $22,400 |
| General Liability | The Hartford | GL-8812-2025 | $1,000,000 / $2,000,000 | $6,800 |
| Commercial Auto | Progressive | CA-3391-2025 | $1,000,000 CSL | $4,200 |
| Workers Compensation | Pinnacol Assurance | WC-5541-2025 | Statutory | $8,600 |
| Property (equipment/contents) | Nationwide | CP-7712-2025 | $220,000 | $2,400 |
| Business Owner Policy (BOP) | The Hartford | BP-2214-2025 | Bundled GL/Property | $1,600 |

Total Annual Premium: $46,000 (approximate)

Note on Technology E&O / Cyber: Several MSA clients (Apex Financial Group, Rocky Mountain Credit Union, TrueNorth Insurance) contractually require evidence of Technology E&O coverage of $1M or more as a condition of their managed services agreements. Maintaining this coverage is required to retain these clients.

*Issued by: Summit Risk Partners, Denver, CO | Contact: Derek Ortega | dortega@summitrisk.com*
